fixed: A filter you chose no longer goes on narrowing the list out of sight once no dance has that value: the Filters panel keeps it as a selected chip you can remove, even when the whole section would otherwise be hidden, and a level, author or source that has since been deleted reads Not in your library. A By phrase pick in a phrase no dance has any more keeps its row too.
Typing a number into a custom number filter, such as a lone minus sign or the first bound of Between, no longer clears what you typed.

added: FacetSelections.keepSelectedTags marks the selected tags a host opened with, which retainTags then keeps even while no live dance carries them; a tag picked by hand is dropped as before. CollectionPanelState.fromSavedSearch says a state was read from a saved search; SavedSearchSpec.toPanelState sets it.
